title: Approaching historical mud loss zone
message: 18 m to the 2758–2885 m interval where 5 offset well(s) had mud loss.

evidence.narrative: Partial losses of 38 bbl/hr while drilling Kopili shale-limestone interbeds; ECD 10.9 ppg against 10.26 ppg pore pressure. Pit volume down 55 bbl over 90 min. Depth 2806.5 m MD.
evidence.mitigation: Reduced flow rate from 2200 to 1800 lpm, spotted 40 bbl medium/fine CaCO3 + nut-plug LCM pill, cut mud weight 0.2 ppg
evidence.outcome: Losses cured after second pill; resumed drilling with reduced ROP

evidence.narrative: Total losses at top Sylhet Limestone — returns dropped from 100% to 0% in fractured, vugular limestone. Annulus level dropped, well monitored on trip tank. Depth 2788.3 m MD.
evidence.mitigation: Pumped 60 bbl cross-linked LCM pill, squeezed with 50 bbl cement plug, drilled out and continued with 10.6 ppg SBM and managed ECD
evidence.outcome: Returns regained after cement squeeze; 22 h NPT

evidence.narrative: Lost circulation encountered at 2658.5m in Kopili. Total fluid loss of 27.0 bbl. Pumped 24.0 bbl medium-nut-plug LCM pill at 1550 lpm. Returned to full circulation after 1.6 hrs.
evidence.mitigation: Pumped LCM pill; reduced mud weight; staged cementing squeeze

evidence.narrative: Seepage losses of 18 bbl/hr in lower Kopili while circulating bottoms-up. Depth 2842.9 m MD.
evidence.mitigation: Added 15 ppb fine CaCO3 background LCM, reduced pump rate by 10%

evidence.narrative: Partial loss of circulation at 1835.5m (Barail Sandstone). Loss rate 76 bbl/hr. Reduced ECD by lowering mud weight from 10.7 to 10.1 ppg. Regained returns in 3.9 hrs.
evidence.mitigation: Pumped LCM pill; reduced mud weight; staged cementing squeeze

recommendation.summary: Pre-mix 25 bbl medium-nut-plug LCM pill; prepare lost circulation contingency; monitor pit volume continuously

title: Inside historical kick zone
